Le CERI MP développe notamment des compétences en génie civil, éco-matériaux, économie circulaire, matériaux biosourcés et géosourcés, recyclage, valorisation des déchets, durabilité des matériaux, essais multi-physiques, modélisation et procédés numériques.

Dans un contexte de transformation du secteur de la construction, le BIM constitue un levier majeur pour concevoir, construire, exploiter, réhabiliter et déconstruire les bâtiments de manière plus durable. Le recrutement vise à renforcer l'offre de formation d'IMT Nord Europe dans le domaine du BIM et à développer une activité de recherche originale à l'interface entre la maquette numérique, la connaissance des matériaux, l'éco-conception, l'économie circulaire et la performance globale des bâtiments sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie.

Dans ce cadre, IMT Nord Europe recrute un Enseignant Chercheur ou une Enseignante Chercheuse dont les missions sont décrites ci-après.

MISSIONS :

Sous l'autorité du directeur du CERI Matériaux & Procédés, le ou la titulaire du poste aura pour mission de développer des enseignements et des activités de recherche dans le domaine du BIM appliqué aux performances durables des bâtiments. Il ou elle contribuera à former des ingénieurs capables d'utiliser la maquette numérique et les données du bâtiment pour concevoir, optimiser, suivre et améliorer les performances des ouvrages, depuis la phase de conception jusqu'à l'exploitation, la rénovation, la déconstruction et la valorisation des matériaux en fin de vie.

Le poste s'inscrit dans une logique d'intégration formation-recherche-innovation. Il devra permettre de créer un lien fort entre les compétences du CERI MP en matériaux de construction durables, procédés, recyclage et valorisation matière, et les besoins émergents du secteur du bâtiment en matière de BIM, d'openBIM, d'analyse du cycle de vie, de pilotage de la performance et d'aide à la décision.

•      Contribuer au développement et à l'animation des enseignements en BIM, matériaux durables et performance des bâtiments dans les formations d'ingénieur et de master ;

•      Développer une activité de recherche sur l'amélioration des performances des bâtiments sur leur cycle de vie, en intégrant les dimensions matériaux, environnementales, économiques et d'exploitation.

Activités d'enseignement :

La personne recrutée participera aux cours, TD, TP, projets et encadrements dans le parcours Génie Civil Environnement, le DNM ADMODC – Advanced Design and Management of Durable Constructions, ainsi que dans les enseignements liés au BIM, aux matériaux durables et aux performances des bâtiments. Elle pourra également intervenir dans d'autres formations de l'école, en formation initiale, apprentissage ou formation continue, selon les besoins pédagogiques.

•      Concevoir, assurer et faire évoluer des enseignements de niveau ingénieur et master sur les fondamentaux du BIM, la maquette numérique, l'openBIM, l'IFC, la coordination BIM et le management de l'information ;

•      Développer des enseignements appliqués liant BIM, matériaux de construction, éco-conception, analyse du cycle de vie, indicateurs carbone, performance énergétique, performance environnementale et durabilité des ouvrages ;

•      Mettre en place des TD et TP mobilisant : modélisation BIM, extraction et structuration de données, couplage BIM-simulation, BIM-ACV, gestion des informations matériaux, scénarios de rénovation et de fin de vie ;

•      Encadrer des projets intégrateurs permettant aux élèves de travailler en équipe sur un bâtiment réel ou un cas industriel : conception collaborative, choix des matériaux, estimation des impacts, suivi des performances et stratégie de valorisation matière ;

•      Participer à l'encadrement de stages, projets de fin d'études, alternants, projets de recherche et travaux d'étudiants en lien avec les entreprises et les plateformes expérimentales du CERI MP ;

•      Contribuer à l'amélioration continue des maquettes pédagogiques, à l'approche par compétences et à la cohérence avec les attendus de la formation d'ingénieur.

Activités de recherche et de transfert de technologie :

La personne recrutée développera, au sein du CERI MP, une activité de recherche portant sur l'amélioration des performances durables des bâtiments sur l'ensemble de leur cycle de vie, en s'appuyant sur le BIM comme support d'intégration, de structuration et d'exploitation des données relatives aux matériaux, aux procédés, aux usages et aux performances.

•      Développer des méthodes permettant d'enrichir les maquettes BIM avec des données matériaux fiables : propriétés mécaniques, thermiques, hydriques, environnementales, durabilité, vieillissement, réparabilité, potentiel de réemploi et recyclabilité ;

•      Intégrer l'éco-conception dans les processus BIM à travers l'aide au choix des matériaux, l'analyse de solutions constructives bas carbone, l'évaluation multicritère et le couplage avec l'analyse du cycle de vie et l'analyse des coûts sur le cycle de vie ;

•      Construire des approches numériques pour optimiser le recyclage, le réemploi et la valorisation matière en fin de vie des bâtiments, notamment via des inventaires BIM, des passeports matériaux, la traçabilité des ressources et des scénarios de déconstruction sélective ;

•      Prendre en compte la performance réelle des bâtiments pendant leur exploitation en reliant les données BIM aux données de monitoring, de capteurs, de GTB/GTC, de maintenance, d'usage et de consommation ;

•      Traiter les questions d'interopérabilité, de qualité et de gouvernance des données : formats IFC, openBIM, bases de données matériaux, ontologies, modèles de données, tableaux de bord d'indicateurs et aide à la décision ;

•      Valoriser les moyens expérimentaux du CERI MP pour produire des données matériaux utiles aux modèles numériques, aux maquettes BIM et aux outils d'aide au choix des solutions constructives durables ;

•      Publier les résultats dans des revues et conférences reconnues et contribuer à l'encadrement de doctorants, post-doctorants, ingénieurs, stagiaires de master et projets de fin d'études recherche.

Recherche partenariale, innovation et valorisation :

Un volet important du poste portera sur le développement de collaborations avec les acteurs industriels et territoriaux de la construction durable. La personne recrutée devra contribuer à faire émerger des projets de recherche appliquée, des démonstrateurs et des cas d'usage en lien avec les besoins du secteur.

•      Développer des partenariats avec les entreprises du BTP, bureaux d'études, maîtres d'ouvrage, maîtres d'œuvre, exploitants de bâtiments, industriels des matériaux, plateformes de recyclage, acteurs de la déconstruction et éditeurs ou intégrateurs de solutions BIM ;

•      Monter et piloter des projets collaboratifs : thèses CIFRE, projets régionaux, ADEME, ANR, Horizon Europe, Interreg, chaires industrielles, prestations de recherche et démonstrateurs pédagogiques ou technologiques ;

•      Contribuer à la réponse aux appels à projets, à la rédaction de livrables scientifiques et techniques, à la valorisation des résultats et au transfert vers les entreprises et les collectivités ;

•      Participer à des réseaux académiques et professionnels dans les domaines du BIM, de la construction durable, de l'économie circulaire, des matériaux bas carbone et de la performance du bâtiment.

Contribution à la vie de l'école :

•      Participer aux jurys, soutenances, conseils pédagogiques, actions de promotion, forums, journées portes ouvertes et événements de valorisation scientifique ;

•      Contribuer à la dynamique collective du CERI MP, aux actions transversales avec les autres centres de recherche et aux démarches qualité de l'École ;

•      Accompagner les étudiants dans leur professionnalisation, leur ouverture aux enjeux environnementaux et leur capacité à travailler dans des environnements collaboratifs et numériques.


PROFIL : (Prérequis/ Diplôme)

Le poste s'adresse à une personne titulaire d'un doctorat en génie civil, bâtiment durable, BIM/construction numérique, sciences et ingénierie des matériaux, performance énergétique et environnementale des bâtiments, sciences des données appliquées à la construction, ou dans un domaine proche. Une Habilitation à Diriger des Recherches, une expérience postdoctorale, une expérience d'enseignement en école d'ingénieurs ou une expérience industrielle dans le secteur de la construction constitueront des atouts.

Le profil recherché devra combiner une culture scientifique solide, une capacité à enseigner à des élèves ingénieurs et une volonté de construire un programme de recherche partenarial à l'interface entre BIM, matériaux durables, économie circulaire et performance du bâtiment.

Savoir-être :

•      Goût pour l'enseignement et l'accompagnement des élèves ;

•      Capacité à travailler en équipe pluridisciplinaire ;

•      Autonomie, rigueur scientifique et sens de l'organisation ;

•      Capacité d'écoute et de dialogue avec les partenaires industriels ;

•      Esprit d'initiative, créativité et orientation projet ;

•      Sensibilité forte aux enjeux de transition écologique.

Savoir-faire :

•      Concevoir et animer des cours, TD, TP et projets BIM ;

•      Encadrer stages, PFE, alternants, doctorants et projets de recherche ;

•      Monter et piloter des projets collaboratifs avec des entreprises ;

•      Structurer des données BIM et les relier à des indicateurs de performance ;

•      Valoriser des résultats par publications, rapports, démonstrateurs et communications ;

•      Travailler en français et en anglais.

Connaissances :

•      BIM, openBIM, IFC, maquette numérique et coordination BIM ;

•      Matériaux de construction durables, bas carbone, bio/géosourcés, recyclés ;

•      Éco-conception, analyse du cycle de vie, indicateurs carbone et coûts sur cycle de vie ;

•      Réemploi, recyclage, valorisation matière et déconstruction sélective ;

•      Performance énergétique, environnementale et hygrothermique des bâtiments.

La maîtrise d'outils ou environnements tels que Revit, Archicad, Tekla, Navisworks, Solibri, Dynamo, Grasshopper, Rhino, eveBIM, logiciels ACV, logiciels de simulation énergétique, bases IFC, Python ou bases de données sera appréciée. Le recrutement privilégiera toutefois la capacité à construire une vision scientifique et pédagogique du BIM plutôt qu'une expertise limitée à un outil logiciel.

La résidence administrative est fixée à Douai. Des déplacements sont à prévoir sur les autres sites de l'école et auprès des partenaires.

Renseignements et modalités de dépôt de candidature :

Pour des informations complémentaires sur les missions, merci de contacter :

•      Pr. Mahfoud BENZERZOUR, Directeur du CERI MP,

•      Pr. Salim CHAKI, Adjoint au Directeur en charge de la Recherche,

•      Pr. Rachid ZENTAR, Adjoint au Directeur en charge de l'Enseignement,

Pour tout renseignement administratif, merci de vous adresser à la Direction des Ressources Humaines : (Merci de ne pas transmettre votre candidature par e-mail. Seules les candidatures déposées via notre plateforme Recruitee seront prises en compte. Les dossiers envoyés par d'autres moyens, y compris à l'adresse ----- ne pourront être traités conformément à notre politique de protection des données.)

Cet emploi est proposé en mobilité pour un fonctionnaire ou bien sous forme de contractuel de droit public.

Par ailleurs, le poste peut être aménagé pour une personne en situation de handicap.

Informations à usage interne à destination des personnels sur Cadre de Gestion de l'IMT :

INFORMATIONS SUR L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL A IMT NORD EUROPE

DOSSIER DE CANDIDATURE :

data.description:
Présentation de l'Ecole :

Grande Ecole de management de l’IMT-Institut Mines-Télécom, premier groupe d’écoles d’ingénieurs de France, Institut Mines-Télécom Business School est une Grande Ecole publique qui forme des managers et des entrepreneurs responsables, innovants et ouverts sur le monde, afin de guider les entreprises dans les transitions au cœur de la société de demain, avec une expertise particulière dans le management du numérique et des technologies. Elle partage son campus avec Télécom SudParis, également membre de l’IMT. L’Ecole compte 1500 étudiants, figure chaque année au classement des meilleures business schools françaises et européennes, et est accréditée AACSB et AMBA. L’Ecole propose des formations allant du post-Bac (Bachelor – Grade Licence) à l’Executive Education en passant par le Programme Grande Ecole délivrant un diplôme Bac+5 (Grade Master). Vidéo de présentation d’Institut Mines-Télécom Business School

À propos de l'Institut Mines-Télécom :

L'Institut Mines-Télécom (IMT) est un établissement public dédié à l'enseignement supérieur et la recherche pour l'innovation dans les domaines de l'ingénierie et du numérique. À l’écoute permanente du monde économique, l'IMT conjugue une forte légitimité académique et scientifique, une proximité avec les entreprises et un positionnement unique sur les transformations majeures au XXIe siècle : numériques, énergétiques, industrielles et éducatives siècle. Ses activités se déploient au sein des grandes écoles Mines et Télécom sous tutelle du ministre en charge de l’Industrie et des communications électroniques, de deux filiales et de partenaires associés ou sous convention. L'IMT est membre fondateur de l’Alliance Industrie du Futur. Il est doublement labellisé Carnot pour la qualité de sa recherche partenariale. Vidéo de présentation de l'Institut Mines-Télécom

Compétences, connaissances et expériences souhaitables

Capacités et aptitudes

Ta mission 🎯
 
En tant que Head of Product, tu seras amené·e à guider nos clients (Decathlon, Carrefour, SeLoger, Chanel, Deezer, ...) dans leur transformation Produit et l’amélioration de leurs pratiques, soit en immersion au sein des équipes, soit en tant que Coach ou expert Produit. 
 
Tu seras également le Manager / la Manageuse d'une équipe chez Thiga pour faire d'eux·elles les meilleur·e·s consultant·e·s & Product People possibles ! 
 
Tu auras pour mission de :

- évaluer la maturité produit d’équipes en place et proposer un plan d’action approprié pour optimiser l’organisation et les processus Produit ;

data.title: Data Center Technician (all genders)
data.description:
Your creative field

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Data Center Technician (all genders) to join our new data center in Lauterbourg as soon as possible.
 

Our customers all around the world rely on Contabo's infrastructure. With our support they run their businesses and store their data. What they never see is what makes it all possible: the humming servers, the precisely cooled halls and our power systems that never sleep.
That's your world.
As a Data Center Technician at our Lauterbourg site, you are the person who makes sure the lights stay on. You know your facility better than anyone: every cable tray, every cooling unit, every alarm.
You monitor and maintain our complete infrastructure: electrical systems from MV/LV distribution to grounding, UPS systems kept tested and ready and HVAC/cooling systems that keep everything running at optimal temperature and efficiency.
You work hands-on with our Building Management System, catch issues before they become incidents and when something does go wrong, you're the one who keeps calm, diagnoses fast and gets things back on track.
 
Beyond day-to-day operations, you'll plan and execute preventive maintenance, coordinate with external subcontractors and continuously push to make our processes sharper and more reliable. Over time, you'll take the lead on maintenance activities, develop predictive approaches and eventually help shape the infrastructure strategy itself. Also it’s important that you have fun to pass your knowledge on to our technicians in the team.

To be honest: there's never been a more exciting time to join us. We're not just maintaining a data center; we're still in the process building one hall. A brand-new HPC facility is taking shape on site and you'll be part of that from The Ground up. Your fingerprints will be on the infrastructure that powers Contabo's next chapter.


What convinces us

Your personality, paired with:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in facilities, HVAC or electrical maintenance
  • Knowledge of HVAC and cooling systems -  this is your core strength
  • Familiarity with electrical systems (MV/LV), UPS and BMS platforms
  • Valid electrical safety or HVAC certification (or equivalent)
  • Safety-first mindset: you follow protocols and set the standard for others
  • Cool under pressure, reliable and comfortable with on-call rotations
  • Strong communicator who works well in a team and with external contractors
  • Good English skills; German and/or French are a plus
  • Data center or industrial facility background is also a plus
  • Technical diploma or vocational training in electrical engineering, HVAC or facility management is a helpful add on
 
We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.


Awesome Prospects

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.
What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

  • an extra day off to get involved in social activities as part of our Volunteer Day.
  • attractive conditions on many products and services through our corporate benefits program.
  • unforgettable moments at our company events and team events.


How to reach us

data.description:
About us

Founded in 2019 and part of Y Combinator's 2020 cohort, Photoroom is the leading visual solution for e-commerce.

We're a team of 100+ passionate builders giving e-commerce businesses superpowers to create visuals that help them grow, making the hardest parts of selling online disappear. We focus on craft, innovation, and collaboration to create exceptional impact for e-commerce businesses worldwide.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to own the self-serve product experience for our SMB customers: small to medium brands selling on Shopify and beyond. The proposition for this segment is unbuilt, the squad is yours to shape, and you'll own the slice of ARR that comes with it. Working closely with engineers, designers, and AI researchers, you'll decide what gets built, why, and how it ships

Location: Paris, hybrid 3 days in the office. We offer relocation support

About the role

  • Own a real slice of the self-serve product. From idea to shipped feature, you will build and execute the roadmap that solves problems for our users.

  • Define the problem before the solution. Sharpen the user problem, then partner with design and engineering to ship work that feels effortless.

  • Turn AI capabilities into products people want. Work hand-in-hand with our researchers and engineers to convert new model capabilities into shipped features that move usage and revenue.

  • Stay close to the user. Talk to e-commerce sellers every week, and feed what you hear directly into roadmap decisions.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won’t need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've shipped products you can defend in detail. Five+ years as a PM, with multiple launches where you can name the user problem, what you owned personally vs. the team, and the measured outcome.

  • You've built B2B SaaS for self-serve customers. You know the mechanics of self-serve growth, retention, and pricing, not just enterprise sales cycles.

  • AI has reshaped how you work. You use Claude or equivalent every day, for prototyping, testing with users, or automating the parts of the job that used to fill your calendar. The value you bring sits in strategy and direction, not in writing tickets.

  • You have demonstrable product taste. You can show specific work where the details matter and explain the calls you made, including the ones you'd make differently now.

  • You create clarity from ambiguity. Given a fuzzy problem, you take action rather than waiting for direction: you structure it, decide what matters, and move.

  • You're data-fluent. You pull, interpret, and challenge data yourself, and use it to form a point of view rather than confirm one.

  • You thrive in small teams with high autonomy. You can ship without being managed, and can operate in a fully remote, async-first environment that offers no scaffolding around you.

Nice to have: experience building creative tools or any product where craft and visual quality matter; an understanding of photography or videography; entrepreneurial experience (you've started, built, or run something).

data.description:

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager, SMB E-commerce Growth to own activation, monetization, and retention for our SMB e-commerce segment across the Photoroom mobile and web apps. This is a growth role: you'll own the levers that turn sign-ups into retained subscribers, and the growth-led features that move them. From paywalls to pricing experiments and onboarding and discovery flows, you'll partner closely with User Acquisition on the handoff from paid to product, and with the core SMB product team on what gets built next.

Location: Paris, we offer relocation support

About the role

  • Own a real slice of the growth funnel. Activation, paywall, pricing, or retention: you'll lead a squad and own a specific number end-to-end, deciding what gets tested, what gets built, and what gets killed.

  • Move the metric, not just the backlog. Run a high-velocity experimentation program across web and mobile funnels. Ship A/B tests weekly, and bigger feature bets when the data calls for them.

  • Find the insight, then build the feature. The best growth work is spotting why users drop off and shipping the change that fixes it. You'll do both.

  • Work across web and mobile. Mobile and web funnels behave differently (App Store vs. card-on-file, push vs. email). You'll own both, and partner closely with the User Acquisition team on the handoff from paid to product.

  • Use data to decide, not to justify. Pull and interpret data yourself, form hypotheses, measure what shipped, and call what's next. You won't need to wait around for someone else to run the query.

About You

  • You've moved real numbers on a subscription product. Five to eight years as a PM, with concrete activation, monetization, or retention wins you can name with the KPI, the change, and the percentage impact, owned by you, not by a team you sat on.

  • You've worked on something with recurring revenue. Whether B2B SaaS, B2C subscription, or B2B2C, as long as your work was tied directly to revenue your experience will give you a leg up. Pure marketplace or pure free-product backgrounds will struggle here.

  • You know how SMB sellers buy. You understand how SMB e-commerce sellers discover, evaluate, and adopt utility SaaS, the kind of motion behind Shopify, Canva, Klaviyo, Stripe, Klarna, Gorgias, Recharge, Loop, Wix, or Squarespace.

  • You think in funnels. You understand activation curves, paywall psychology, trial design, and the difference between credit-based, feature-gated, and seat-based pricing, and you have opinions on which works where.

  • You build with AI. You use Claude or equivalent to automate recurring tasks, and can explain how you set it up to help you ship faster.

  • You're data-fluent. Comfortable with SQL and an analytics platform like Amplitude or Mixpanel; you build and interpret your own funnel without waiting for a data scientist, and you've shipped a high volume of A/B tests personally in the last 12 months.

data.title: HR Business Partner, EMEA
data.description:
About the Team

OpenAI’s People team aims to hire, engage, and retain world-class talent to safely build and deploy universally beneficial Artificial General Intelligence (AGI). The HR team, a vital subset of the People team, supports a diverse group of scientists, engineers, and business professionals, with expertise spanning employee relations, immigration, compensation and benefits, learning and development, project management, and more.

About the Role

We’re seeking an HR Business Partner to support our growing teams across EMEA, with a particular focus on France. This role will help build scalable, locally compliant people practices and support strong employee relations as we grow.

You will partner closely with regional People leadership, Legal, Employee Relations, and other People COEs to strengthen our approach to employee relations and employee representation in France. This will include building practical governance, manager practices, and operating processes that are compliant and sustainable as we scale.

Beyond France, this role will serve as a trusted HR partner to managers and teams across EMEA. You will combine strong operational execution with thoughtful business judgment to support performance, organizational health, employee relations, and disciplined people practices at scale.

This role reports into the International HRBP Lead, who owns regional organizational design and workforce planning. You will operate as a key regional execution partner to them, translating strategic direction into consistent delivery, elevating manager capability, and proactively surfacing people risks and themes.

If you're joining us in person, we offer relocation support and follow a hybrid schedule: three days a week in the office, with the option to work from home on Thursdays and Fridays. Our offices are designed for focus and connection, with spaces for both individual work and collaboration.

Your Responsibilities

  • Lead employee-representative work in France: Partner with Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, and local stakeholders to own and deliver CSE-related processes, including elections, consultations, employee communications, documentation, governance, and effective ongoing operating rhythms.

  • Build sustainable employee relations processes: Help establish clear processes for engaging with employee representatives, preparing for required information and consultation processes, maintaining appropriate documentation, and coordinating inputs from relevant business and People stakeholders.

  • Support managers operating in the French employee relations environment: Equip managers and leaders with practical guidance on working effectively within French employment and employee-representation frameworks, escalating complex matters to Legal or specialist teams as appropriate.

  • Drive strong day-to-day HR execution: Partner with managers across EMEA to support performance management cycles, feedback conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations matters with consistency and care.

  • Be the go-to partner for frontline managers: Provide practical, timely guidance on team health, coaching conversations, policy interpretation, performance management, and manager enablement.

  • Support and operationalize People programs: Help implement and maintain performance, engagement, retention, and employee experience initiatives, ensuring processes are clear, scalable, and well executed across different EMEA jurisdictions.

  • Triage and resolve employee relations issues: Identify issues early, assess risk, recommend appropriate actions, and partner with Employee Relations, Legal, and other COEs on complex or sensitive matters.

  • Maintain operational rigor: Track employee relations themes, maintain complete and accurate documentation, coordinate recurring processes, and ensure actions and commitments are followed through.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally: Work closely with HRBPs, Legal, Employee Relations, People Operations, Total Rewards, and other COEs to provide a consistent and high-quality employee experience across EMEA.

We’re Seeking

  • Strong HR foundation: Approximately 8+ years of HR experience, including meaningful experience partnering directly with managers in fast-paced, high-growth, or complex international environments as a Senior HR Generalist or HR Business Partner.

  • French employee relations experience: Practical experience working with French employment practices and employee representative bodies. Direct experience establishing, supporting, or working closely with a CSE, works council, or comparable employee representative structure is highly valued.

  • Experience with employee representative processes: Familiarity with employee elections, consultation processes, employee representative communications, and the governance and documentation associated with formal employee representation.

  • Execution-oriented partnership: Comfortable owning detailed, time-sensitive workstreams and coordinating across multiple stakeholders while maintaining sound judgment and strong follow-through.

  • Strong project management: Able to take complex, multi-stage employee-representative processes and translate them into clear milestones, owners, dependencies, communications, and operating processes.

  • Manager coaching capability: Able to guide managers through performance conversations, organizational changes, and employee relations issues with clarity and confidence.

  • Operational strength: Brings structure, organization, and discipline to people processes and can build repeatable practices as the organization scales.

  • Good judgment under pressure: Balances empathy, employee experience, business needs, and appropriate risk management while handling sensitive matters with discretion.

  • High integrity: Trusted, fair, principled, and comfortable operating in an environment where confidentiality and sound judgment are essential.

  • Language capability: Professional fluency in French and English is strongly preferred given the role’s responsibility for supporting employee relations and representative processes in France.

data.title: Head of Financial Controller
data.description:
🌀 The Company

Founded in 2022, Filigran is a global cybersecurity company on a mission to empower defense teams to be proactive through open-source solutions that uncover threats and drive action.

Filigran stands out in the cybersecurity ecosystem through its open-source, AI-powered and threat-informed approach to Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). Our eXtended Threat Management (XTM) platform brings together threat intelligence, exposure validation and cyber risk reduction, enabling organizations to better understand their threat landscape and take action.

At the heart of Filigran is our open-source approach. Our vision is to unite defenders into a global community to make security more open, resilient and collaborative.

As Filigran continues to scale globally, we are building the organization, infrastructure and capabilities needed for our next stage of growth. How we scale matters just as much as how fast we scale: our CORE values: Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity shape how we work together, make decisions and build for the future.

 

🎯 The Role

As Head of Financial Controller, you will own the full accounting function across Filigran's entities, including revenue recognition, consolidation, monthly and year-end close, and internal controls. You will act as the finance function's technical backbone building the infrastructure, controls, and processes needed to support a fast-scaling, multi-entity, international organization.

You will report directly to the VP of Finance. The team is small so this role demands both strategic ownership and significant hands-on execution.

💼 Your Responsibilities

General Accounting Operations

  • Own the accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of all financial transactions across Filigran entities

  • Continuously improve a scalable monthly/quarterly close process

  • Ensure revenue recognition is correctly applied and documented

Multi-Entity Oversight

  • Lead consolidation across Filigran's growing international entity structure (including new entity set-ups as the company expands)

  • Partner with the VP of Finance on transfer pricing, inter company transactions, and cross-border compliance matters

Controls, Risk & Governance

  • Perform ongoing gap analyses of accounting processes and proactively design and implement internal controls and policies

  • Manage the yearly financial audit end-to-end, acting as the primary point of contact for auditors

  • Own the relationship with the external accounting firm, holding them to a high standard of accuracy and responsiveness

Systems & Scalability

  • Identify opportunities to automate and streamline accounting workflows

  • Build documentation that make the accounting function auditable and transferable

Leadership & Cross-Functional Support

  • Act as a thought partner to the VP of Finance on technical accounting matters and process design

  • Manage a current team of 3 general accountants.

  • Grow the team to help support scalability and growth.

  • Support ad hoc business requests, including finance topics adjacent to accounting (e.g., payroll coordination)

🔎 Preferred Experience

  • 10+ years in accounting roles, including senior/lead or controller-level experience

  • Strong knowledge of French accounting standards; exposure to multi-GAAP/consolidation environments is a strong plus

  • Proven ability to build processes and internal controls from scratch in a fast-growing or scaling environment

  • Comfortable operating with high autonomy and ambiguity; adapts quickly to change

  • Prior people management experience

🌱 Why Join Filigran? More than just a job.

We are a fast-growing, global and remote-first company, and we believe the best work combines purpose, impact and innovation. You’ll work alongside talented people across the world who care about what they build, how they build it, and the impact they make on the broader cybersecurity ecosystem.

⭐ Be part of something bigger

We believe we do work that matters. Our open-source approach means that work extends beyond Filigran. You’re contributing to technology and ideas that strengthen a global community of defenders and help make cybersecurity more open and collaborative.

💻 Work at the edge of what’s next

We bring together cybersecurity, open source and AI — giving you the opportunity to work with emerging technologies, experiment with new ways of working, and contribute to how they are applied in practice.

🌍 Global opportunity without borders

Be part of a fast-growing, truly international team — collaborating across Europe, North America, APJ and beyond, with the flexibility of a remote-first environment. As we grow, you’ll have opportunities to expand your scope, take ownership, learn quickly and grow with us.

🧭 A culture grounded in CORE

Cohesion, Openness, Responsibility and Equity define how we work together — with openness, ownership, collaboration and respect. These are the principles that guide how we make decisions, treat people and grow together, especially when no one’s watching.

💰 What you can expect

  • Competitive compensation + equity — everyone shares in our success

  • Remote-first flexibility — work from wherever you’re based, with flexibility built into how we operate

  • 25 days PTO baseline — real time to disconnect, recharge and enjoy life outside work

  • Volunteer days — paid time to contribute to causes that matter to you

  • Set up for success — choose the equipment that works for you, with additional support for your remote work and development needs as our programs evolve

  • Two annual in-person get-togethers — one global company get-together and one team get-together, creating dedicated time to connect, collaborate and strengthen our culture beyond the screen

🌍 Equal Employment Opportunity

We enable cybersecurity through inclusion — from code to culture.

At Filigran, we are proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe the diversity of our people makes our products and our team stronger. We welcome talent of every background, identity and lived experience, regardless of race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability or veteran status.

What matters here is what you bring, not what you look like, where you’re from or how you identify.

  • Piloter l’activité avec réactivité et proactivité : coordonner un portefeuille varié de demandes et de dossiers, en apportant une réponse adaptée aux sollicitations du quotidien et en conduisant en parallèle une dizaine de dossiers individuels et contentieux complexes à forts enjeux.

  • Qualités rédactionnelles : Une excellente plume juridique pour la rédaction rapide et irréprochable des actes, contrats, avenants et courriers disciplinaires ;

Voodoo’s Corporate function is composed of three teams: HR, Legal and Finance, working together to drive Voodoo’s success.

Role

We're looking for an IT Administrator - AI & Cybersecurity to join our Corporate team. In this role, you'll own the intersection of IT operations, cybersecurity and AI platform administration, reporting directly to the IT Manager.

IT & SaaS Administration

  • Administer the core SaaS stack - Okta (SSO, SCIM, lifecycle, policies), Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, GitHub Enterprise Cloud and 100+ applications across multiple legal entities

data.description:
Health can’t wait.

Not for symptoms to get worse. Not for a six‑month appointment. Not for a system to catch up. But that’s exactly how healthcare works today. You wait, until you can’t.

Alan exists to end the wait.

Health is a universal right, and we believe this right can only become real when it’s coupled with prevention. We need to stop treating health as something we repair and start treating it as something we build, every day. It’s not solely a question of willpower. It’s the healthcare system itself that needs to work for everyone, in a sustainable way.

So we are building the new standard in prevention insurance. Alan is the first company that integrates insurance, prevention, and care into a single, acclaimed user experience.

We are on an incredible journey to build a global leading company, with a unique culture. We already partner with 40K+ companies of all sizes, serving more than 1M+ members, and have reached €800M+ in ARR.

Prevention as the new norm. That's what we're building with our team of 1000+ people. If it speaks to you: we're hiring across France, Spain, Belgium, and Canada. And beyond.

⭐️ The Data Foundations team ⭐

At Alan, every decision we make about our members' care, contracts and claims is a data decision. The Data Foundations team builds the platform that makes those decisions possible in a safe way.

  • Being part of the Data Foundations team means you’ll build, maintain, and improve the Data Platform used by everyone at Alan.

  • We enable Alan’s data-driven nature and help our colleagues make the most of their data.

  • Partner closely with people across Alan (technical and non-technical) to understand their needs and build data solutions they can trust and use effectively.

  • We own and manage all data-related tools that power Alan.

  • AI is changing the way companies work with data: agents are becoming first-class users of our data warehouse. It opens a world of new usage and exciting features, as well as concerns around security, data quality and governance. We are building the foundations that allow Alan to make the most of this exciting new paradigm.

  • Alan is expanding quickly: we went from 4 to 6 countries this year and we won’t stop there. Our objective is to onboard new countries in weeks, not months. Having strong data foundations is a cornerstone of that expansion, allowing our teams to make sense of a patchwork of insurance systems, regulations and reporting rules.

  • Examples of our missions:

    • improve the developer experience when building and maintaining data pipelines,

    • enable reliable and secure access to our data warehouse for Alaners and AI agents,

    • strengthen security and governance around our data assets,

    • define and implement standard data practices across Alan,

    • maintain and evolve our core data infrastructure to accommodate Alan's international expansion and growing product breadth…

  • Our core tools include Python, Airflow, Snowflake, AWS/GCP, Metabase, Terraform, dbt, and others.

  • Who you'll work with: Data Foundations is a small, high-leverage team inside the Tech Foundations area, whose mission is to enable product crews through world-class infrastructure, developer experience, operational excellence, and built-in security. You'd be joining as one of its core engineers, working daily with the whole Data community at Alan.

🎯 Expected skills and abilities

data.description:
Who are we?

Cohere is the leading security-first enterprise AI company. We build cutting-edge foundation AI models and end-to-end products that are designed to solve real-world business problems.

We’re training and deploying frontier models for enterprises who are building AI systems. We believe that our work is instrumental to the widespread adoption of AI and we are looking for folks that want to be part of that.

We obsess over what we build. Each one of us is responsible for contributing to increasing the capabilities of our models and the value they drive for our customers. Cohere is a team of researchers, engineers, designers, and more, who are all passionate about their craft.

We are a global technology company headquartered in Toronto with key offices in London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul. Join us!

Why this role?

In this role as a Solutions Architect (SA) for Cohere in the Southern Europe region, you will play an instrumental part in growing Cohere’s business across France, Spain, Italy and the wider European region. You will partner with account executives, our partner ecosystem and executive leadership to help the region's leading enterprises and public institutions adopt AI securely and at scale, building on Cohere's success with organisations in defence, financial services, Telecommunications, Energy and the public sector.

SAs at Cohere sit at the cross-section of Forward Deployed Engineering and AI transformation. Our SAs embody the following traits:

  • Technical experts in the field

  • Trusted advisors to customers and colleagues

  • Product evangelists of Cohere technology

  • Thought leaders in pushing the frontiers of applied AI

Responsibilities include developing a deep understanding of customer problems, mapping them to Cohere solutions, and working closely with our partners as the trusted technical advisor who owns the technical relationship with our stakeholders. By leveraging your expertise, you will help to increase the adoption of Cohere products, both internally and externally, and will gather valuable insights and feedback from customers to help shape the future of our products.

In this dynamic and demanding role, you will need to be both a strategic thinker and a builder. You will personally lead the design and deployment of customer pilots that showcase the impact of our technology to strategic enterprise and government customers.

You will own the customer's technical narrative end to end, from discovery and architecture to pilot results and business case, and bring structured customer feedback back to our Product and Engineering teams.

A typical day at Cohere might include:

  • Leading the technical talk track on customer calls.

  • Designing enterprise architectures for North deployments.

  • Deep dives on customer queries and Cohere technology.

  • Working with customer executives to prioritise use cases, define success metrics and build the business case for AI adoption.

  • Facilitating customer evaluations and pilots inside their stack

  • Developing and documenting processes to enable the solutions architect team and adjacent teams to scale effectively within Cohere.

  • Collaborating with the Product and Engineering teams to ensure our offering matches the customers’ needs.

  • Working closely with our partners to develop a strategy for enabling and accelerating their customers.

This might be for you if you have some of the following:

  • 3+ years in customer-facing technical roles where you both built and advised, such as consulting data scientist, forward deployed engineer or deployment strategist, or solutions architect, taking AI or data solutions from executive problem framing to production.

  • A passion for Agentic AI, and a practical understanding of where LLMs deliver value in production, and where they don't.

  • Solid grounding in ML fundamentals (training, evaluation, retrieval etc.) and the ability to design evaluation frameworks for customer pilots.

  • Excellent communication skills - you can toggle seamlessly between presenting to CEOs, and getting in the weeds with technical audiences.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and can put high-impact structure and processes in place where none exist.

  • Comfortable working with Python and Assistive Coding tools

  • Preferred: Fluency in French, Spanish or Italian

  • Must have: Professional fluency in English (business and technical)

Full-Time Employees at Cohere enjoy these Perks:

  • A weekly lunch stipend of $75/£75 or equivalent in your local currency for lunch.

  • Full health and dental benefits, including a separate budget for mental health.

  • RRSP matching, 401K, Pension Scheme.

  • 100% Parental Leave top-up for up to 6 months, for either parent.

  • Annual enrichment benefits:

    Arts & culture, fitness/wellness, quality time, and a workspace improvement credit.

    Education & learning stipend for conferences, courses, and coaching.

  • 6 weeks of paid vacation (30 working days!)

  • Budget for traveling to other offices if you are remote, plus an annual company offsite.

How and Where We Work:

  • Cohere is remote-friendly, but we also have offices in Toronto, London, New York City, San Francisco, Montreal, Paris, Berlin and Seoul with more opening soon.

  • For those in the office: a daily lunch program, plenty of snacks, and regular community and social events.

  • For those not near an office: a co-working benefit so you can work alongside others in your city.

  • Everyone receives a $500 home office stipend to set up your workspace properly.

If any of the above doesn’t line up exactly with your experience, we still encourage you to apply.


We strive to create an inclusive work environment for all; we welcome applicants from all backgrounds and are committed to providing equal opportunities. Should you require any accommodations during the recruitment process, please submit an Accommodations Request Form, and we will work together to meet your needs.

We may use AI-enabled tools to screen and assess applicants against the criteria for this position. This helps our recruiters identify potentially qualified candidates, but it doesn't limit the applications our recruiters may review or consider.

Beware of Scams: Cohere will never ask for payment or third-party services (e.g., CV writing) as part of our hiring process. All legitimate roles are listed on the Cohere careers page and LinkedIn only, with all communications from Cohere employees coming from an ----- or ----- email alias. If jobs are viewed on other sites then please verify these through our official careers page.

data.description:
Do you want to work for the global leader in the language services and technology industry?

Are you interested in helping international brands/organisations find and implement solutions that allow them to communicate, operate and sell their products and services efficiently and effectively? And are you the type of person who enjoys an integrity focused, fast-paced, entrepreneurial, innovative, vibrant environment? Then we'd like to hear from you!

TransPerfect’s vision is to be the world's premier provider of global language and business solutions. We will accomplish this by applying our values, passion, dedication, and innovation to help our clients improve their businesses and achieve their goals on a global scale. Our services portfolio covers everything from business support services such as interpretation, multicultural and digital marketing, SEO and website globalisation to multimedia work, video, e-learning and training, and legal support services. All services and client partnerships are aided by best-in-breed software platforms, specialised in optimising business processes.


That’s enough about us – what about you?

We look for and appreciate anyone who is willing to roll up their sleeves and get stuck in! We offer a fast growth path for career and personal development and provide full training around our services, technology solutions and workflows. Therefore, the key skills we are looking for are solid communication and relationship building abilities, keeping a cool head under pressure and really owning your role, taking responsibility for your clients and their business success.

If this sounds like you, we would love to hear from you! We have over 140 offices worldwide, but this particular opportunity is to be based in one of our offices in Paris, London or Milan.

Position Summary:

The main focus of this role is sales and business development focused on the Life Sciences industry and requires a person with a strong entrepreneurial mindset and a proactive attitude in outbound sales.


Key position responsibilities:

  • Develop prospective clients through several strategies including internet sourcing, trade show lists, referrals, various professional directories and personal investigation

  • Foster and close new clients through referrals, cold calling, networking, and other means (trade shows, regional organisations, etc.)

  • Responsible for growing new business from existing clients, including working closely with senior leadership to expand current relationships and up-sell the TransPerfect portfolio

  • Creatively problem solve to improve current new business development strategy

  • Negotiate rates and deadlines with prospective and current clients

  • Educate prospective and existing clients regarding the translation process, including TransPerfect’s rates, justification for turnaround time, and competitors’ information

  • Liaise with production to ensure that all jobs are handled appropriately and with keen attention to detail, resulting in a perfect product

  • Consistently follow up with clients to ensure their satisfaction with delivery, quality and customer service

  • Understand all industries that TransPerfect markets to including industry leaders, current events and any other pertinent data

  • Perform other special projects or duties when required


Essential skills required:

  • Commit to a high level of integrity and service

  • Superior written and spoken communication skills in French & English

  • Deliver quality work

  • Service focused with a desire to exceed clients’ expectations

  • Owning your performance and taking responsibility

  • Multitask and work with a sense of urgency in a fast-paced environment

  • Commit to always treating everyone (from clients to co-workers to vendors to business partners) with the ultimate level of respect

  • Work well in a team with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures

  • Build and maintain strategic relationships with clients and co-workers

  • Celebrate diversity and embrace new ideas and differing perspectives

  • Be financially responsible and make sound financial decisions

  • Take active measures to achieve results and solve problems

Experience required:

  • Problem solving mindset

  • Strong interpersonal skills with prior experience in a client facing role

  • Strong written and spoken communication skills

  • Good analytical skills with attention to detail

  • Most importantly, the ideal candidate must demonstrate ability to: multitask in a fast-paced environment, work well with people from a variety of different backgrounds and cultures, build strategic relationships with clients and co-workers, work as part of a team, take active measures to solve problems and commit to a high level of service

data.description:
Aircall is a unicorn, AI-powered customer communications platform used by 22,000+ companies worldwide to drive revenue, resolve issues faster, and scale customer-facing teams. We’re redefining customer communications by bringing voice, SMS, WhatsApp, and AI together into one seamless workspace.

Our momentum comes from a simple idea: help teams work smarter, not harder. Aircall’s AI Voice Agent automates routine calls, AI Assist streamlines post-call work, and AI Assist Pro delivers real-time guidance so people can do their best work. The result is higher revenue, faster resolutions, and teams that scale with confidence.

Aircall is headquartered in Paris, our European HQ, with a strong North American presence anchored in Seattle, our North American HQ, and teams across Madrid, London, Berlin, San Francisco, New York City, Sydney, and Mexico City. We’ve built a product customers love and a business that’s scaling quickly, backed by world-class investors and driven by rapid AI innovation across multiple product lines.
At Aircall, you’ll join a company in motion. We’re ambitious, product-driven, and execution-focused, with visible impact, fast decisions, and real growth.

How we work at Aircall: We’re customer-obsessed, data-driven, and focused on delivering meaningful outcomes. We value ownership, continuous learning, and thoughtful speed. If you thrive in a collaborative, fast-moving environment where trust and impact matter, you’ll feel at home here.

We are seeking a driven and dynamic individual to join our DACH Partnerships team in the Paris office. You will play a pivotal role in our regional growth and development of one of our largest partner ecosystems.

As a Partner Account Manager, you will help us grow the pipeline and revenue through our Channel partners and Agencies (also defined as System Integrators, Solution Partners, Digital Consulting firms etc).   Your leadership & knowledge of the market will help drive the go-to-market strategy, collaborating with Sales, Marketing, and Outbound to ensure smooth execution and sustained growth in the region.


Key Responsibilities:

Partner Recruitment & Onboarding:

  • Identify, recruit, and onboard new Channel Partners (or System Integrators) that align with our strategic objectives and target markets.

  • Develop and implement effective partner onboarding programs to ensure rapid ramp-up and productivity.

  • Educate partners on Aircall's products, services, value proposition, and sales processes.

    • Partner Relationship Management:

  • Build and maintain strong, long-lasting relationships with key stakeholders within partner organizations.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned partners, addressing their needs, challenges, and opportunities.

  • Conduct regular business reviews with partners to assess performance, identify areas for improvement, and develop joint action plans.

    • Revenue Generation & Sales Enablement:

CONTEXTE

Dans le cadre du renforcement des dispositifs de contrôle de notre client bancaire sur le périmètre Front Office / Risques, vous intégrerez l'équipe chargée d'assurer la conformité et la sécurité des opérations sur les marchés financiers.

En tant que Data Analyst Senior, vous prendrez la responsabilité du périmètre de la surveillance des événements externes à la banque (hors SI) susceptibles d'être qualifiés d'abus de marché (MAR) et devant faire l'objet de déclarations réglementaires. Vous jouerez un rôle référent pour la direction et l'ensemble des parties prenantes.

 

DESCRIPTIF DE LA MISSION

Au quotidien, vous piloterez le sujet en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Risques, Métiers, IT et la Direction autour des axes suivants :

  • Surveillance des événements externes : Identifier, analyser et cadrer l'ensemble des flux et données externes hors SI présentant des suspicions d'abus de marché (MAR).

  • Analyse de flux et réconciliation : Cartographier les schémas de flux de données complexes, concevoir et exécuter les schémas de réconciliation dans une approche stricte orientée Risque.

  • Déclarations réglementaires : Valider les dossiers et formaliser les notifications de suspicion destinées aux régulateurs, en garantissant le respect des contraintes de temporalité.

  • Exploration, Manipulation & Modélisation de données : Traiter et croiser d'importantes volumétries de données (Python, SQL, Excel) pour identifier les anomalies et optimiser les règles de détection.

  • Coordination & Posture : Interagir directement avec les équipes IT pour faire évoluer le dispositif et apporter un rôle de conseil/référent auprès de la direction.

 

Livrables à produire (liste non exhaustive) :

  • Schémas de réconciliation des données et cartographies de flux externes.

  • Fiches d'analyse d'incidents complexes et dossiers de déclaration de suspicion pour le régulateur.

  • Tableaux de bord de suivi des alertes, indicateurs de temporalité et cartographies de risques.

  • Documentation fonctionnelle, préconisations techniques pour l'IT et comptes-rendus d'analyses.


Profil recherché 🔎

  • Formation : Bac+5 (École d'ingénieurs ou Master spécialisé en Finance/Data).

  • Expérience : 8 ans d'expérience minimum en Data Analysis appliquée aux marchés financiers (environnement Front Office et/ou Risques).

  • Expertise métier : Maîtrise approfondie des activités de marché, des mécanismes de réconciliation et de la réglementation sur les abus de marché (MAR).

  • Compétences techniques : Maîtrise avancée de Python, SQL et Excel pour le traitement et la modélisation de données complexes.

  • Soft Skills : Excellente capacité d'analyse, posture affirmée pour rassurer le management, leadership et aisance relationnelle pour challenger les équipes IT et métiers.

data.title: Associate Account Manager (Paris)
data.description:
The AI-powered OS for beauty,
wellness and self-care

About Fresha

Fresha is the AI-powered operating system for the global beauty, wellness and self-care industry, connecting and powering everything from salons and barbers to spas, medspas, fitness studios and health practices.

Trusted by millions of consumers and businesses worldwide. Fresha is used by 140,000+ businesses and 450,000+ stylists and professionals worldwide, processing over 1 billion appointments to date.

The company is headquartered in London, United Kingdom, with 15 global offices located across North America, EMEA and APAC.
Fresha allows consumers to discover, book and pay for beauty and wellness appointments with local businesses via its marketplace, while beauty and wellness businesses and professionals use an all-in-one platform to manage their entire operations with an intuitive business software and financial technology solutions.
 
Fresha’s ecosystem gives merchants everything they need to run their business seamlessly by facilitating appointment bookings, point-of-sale, customer records management, marketing automation, loyalty, beauty products inventory and team management.
 
The consumer marketplace unlocks revenue potential for partner businesses by leveraging the power of online bookings and automated marketing through mobile apps and advanced integrations with major tech brands including Instagram, Facebook and Google.

Role overview
 
Given our exciting and progressive growth plans, we are looking for an exceptional Associate Account Manager to come and join our global business.
 
Reporting directly to the Account Manager Team Lead, you will be accountable for building relationships and driving monetisation of the Fresha platform.
 
This is a great opportunity for someone looking to work in a fast-paced and changing environment, who likes to work autonomously, enjoys a challenge, and wants to make an impact.
 
To foster a collaborative environment that thrives on face-to-face interactions and teamwork, all Fresha employees work from office five days per week in Paris, on the Champs-élysées.

Commercial Growth
  • Engagement - Accountable for meeting key performance indicators on monetisation and revenue growth by proactively engaging with and educating our Partners on the value of the Fresha platform.
  • Sales Cycle - Proactively introduce, educate and convert Partners on to Fresha’s payments solution.
  • Market Trends - Optimise listing content and availability competitiveness on the marketplace to maximise conversions.

    • Relationship Building
  • Partnering - Have a pool of Partner accounts serving as a dedicated advisor for all your Partners assisting them on their journey to product adoption.
  • Advisor - Advising Partners on suitable product selection based on their needs and specifications.
  • Business Partnering - Ensure a strong Partner Experience through building relationships by attending video meetings with your pool of Partners and effectively communicating the Fresha features and benefits.
  • Relationships - Build key internal relationships with our Sales and Onboarding teams to ensure smooth transition and handover of Partners through the Partner journey.
  • Collaboration  - Collaborate with our Product teams to provide important product feedback to help enhance future releases.
  • Persuasion - Use consultative sales techniques to understand customer needs and requirements and have the ability to upsell and cross-sell the Fresha Platform.
    •  
  • This list is not exhaustive and there may be other activities you are required to deliver. 

    • What we are looking for
  • Experience - 1-2 Years experience in effectively delivering commercial outcomes from a previous Account Management role
  • Closing Skills – Demonstrated ability to effectively close deals, negotiate, and convert opportunities
  • Adaptability - Shown to be commercially motivated with an ability to adapt and achieve targets
  • Analytics - Proven experience in using and analysing data and reporting effectively to improve commercial outcomes
  • Curiosity - Naturally proactive and inquisitive, with a desire to consistently learn and improve
  • Tele-prospecting - Previous experience in an outbound call environment or a related sales position preferred
  • Communication - Excellent and proven written, verbal and presentation skills
  • Innovative - Creative thinking and problem-solving mindset
  • Relationship Building - You are a true hunter and relationship builder
  • Team Player - Happy to roll sleeves up and assist the team when required
  • Initiative - Ability to self-starter with a proactive approach

    • Added Bonus
  • Bi-lingual - Fluency in English and another language
  • Beauty & Wellness - Experience within the beauty and wellness industry
    •  
  • At Fresha, we value passion and potential as much as specific skills. If you're enthusiastic and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply, even if you don't meet every listed requirement. We believe in fostering growth and providing the support needed for you to excel in your role.

    • Interview Process
  • Screen Call - Video-call with a member from the Talent Team (30 mins)
  • Skills & Experience - In-Person interview with Team Leads (30 mins)
  • Presentation - In-Person interview with General Manager.
    •  
    We aim to complete the entire interview process and deliver feedback within 2 weeks. 
     
  • Every job application received is reviewed manually by our talent team. While we strive to assess applications within 7 days, the sheer volume of talented individuals expressing interest may occasionally extend this timeframe
    • Inclusive workforce
     
    At Fresha, we are creating a culture where individuals of all backgrounds feel comfortable.
     
    We want all Fresha people to feel included and truly empowered to contribute fully to our vision and goals. Everyone who applies will receive fair consideration for employment.
     
    We do not discriminate based on race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, age, marital status, gender identity, national origin, disability, or any other applicable legally protected characteristics in the location in which the candidate is applying.
     
    If you have any accessibility requirements that would make you more comfortable during the interview process and/or once you join, please let us know so that we can support you.

data.description:
Your mission

Bonjour et bienvenue à Sungrow! We’re seeking a skilled Field Service Engineer to join our vibrant team in the south part of France.

In this role, you will become the primary point of contact for our valued customers, handling technical inquiries and resolving issues efficiently while ensuring the seamless operation of our cutting-edge solar energy products.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Performing on-site installation, maintenance, and upgrade activities.
  • Collaborating closely with project management teams during commissioning and site acceptance phases.
  • Ensuring compliance with operational procedures and all health & safety regulations.
  • Maintaining accurate and up-to-date documentation for current and future service contracts.


Your profile

All right, all right, that was intriguing, wasn't it? Now, in order to fit in this role and be happy for a long time, your ideal background should look a lot like this: 

  • You possess a degree in electrical engineering or have a strong electrician background, providing a solid foundation for technical expertise.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will make our robots navigate dependably across real customer sites. Our stack works. The gap between working and dependable is the whole job. Every new site tests how a robot understands its surroundings and chooses where to go: a ramp the planner avoids, a narrow passage that exposes a poor route, a gate that changes the map, a person who steps into the robot's path, or localization drift that builds over a long patrol. You treat those cases as the real navigation problem to solve, not as edge cases.

You'll shape the technical choices behind reliable navigation, from sensor selection, ground segmentation, and traversability estimation to predicting how people and vehicles move and planning safe, efficient routes around them. The system has to work day and night, in challenging weather, across different embodiments and changing site conditions. We measure success by whether the robot completes its patrol on a live site, not by how it performs in simulation.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Navigation and path-planning design: how robots represent traversable space, select routes, avoid obstacles, and reach goals across complex sites.

  • Sensor integration driven by navigation requirements, including what ground segmentation and traversability estimation need in day, night, and challenging weather.

  • Environment understanding: how the robot distinguishes ground from obstacles and estimates which terrain is safe and practical to traverse.

  • Behavior prediction: anticipate how people, vehicles, and other dynamic obstacles will move, and plan routes that stay safe and efficient around them.

  • Field reliability: reproduce failures from deployments, find the root cause, and fix it at the right layer, from sensor data and maps to costmaps, planners, and recovery behaviors.

  • Planning under imperfect localization: plans that stay useful when the state estimate drifts and the robot must execute routes in tight or dynamic environments, working with the rest of Robot Autonomy on localization and control.

  • Validation on real robots: logs, simulation, and repeatable field tests to verify that design choices and changes hold across routes, lighting, weather, and site layouts.

  • New autonomy capabilities: work with the engineers building the operator application and backend so operator requests and new robot capabilities rest on a sound navigation design.

  • The field feedback loop: work closely with forward-deployed engineers to turn site issues into bugs, design changes, and improvements to the navigation stack.

  • Regular site visits to build a practical understanding of how robots and sensors behave in real operating conditions.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an engineer who has taken a robotics system from unreliable to dependable and takes ownership beyond individual tickets. You can explain why you made a navigation design choice and what it costs. When a robot takes a bad route, you can tell whether the planner, the map, the state estimate, or the robot's behavior is at fault, and you fix the right one. You are comfortable in the field and want to understand how robots behave in real customer environments.

YOUR BACKGROUND:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven track record building and deploying navigation on ground mobile robots in the real world (3+ years or equivalent depth).

  • Hands-on experience with mobile robot navigation and path planning: route or local planning, static and dynamic obstacle avoidance, costmaps, or recovery behaviors.

  • Understanding of how mapping and localization affect navigation, and the ability to diagnose when a planning issue is actually caused by the map, the state estimate, or robot behavior.

  • Understanding of how lighting, weather, terrain, and sensor limitations affect perception and navigation, with experience developing or validating systems for demanding real-world conditions.

  • Hands-on experience with robotics sensors and hardware, especially LiDAR, IMUs, and cameras. You can investigate issues across software, networking, and hardware boundaries.

  • Experience testing and debugging navigation on physical robots using logs, visualization, simulation, and repeatable field tests.

  • Strong ROS 2, C++, and Python skills.

  • Clear communication of navigation and path-planning design choices and their trade-offs.

  • Willingness to visit customer sites regularly.

NICE TO HAVE:

  • Experience with legged robots or with more than one robot embodiment.

  • Experience with Nav2 or a comparable navigation framework.

  • Motion prediction or planning among people and vehicles, such as trajectory forecasting or socially aware navigation.

  • Terrain mapping and traversability methods: elevation mapping, learned traversability, or semantic segmentation for navigation.

  • Experience with night-time or all-weather sensing, such as thermal cameras or LiDAR in rain and fog.

  • Background in security, defence, or other safety-critical robotics deployments.

What We Offer

  • Ownership: you are able to ship products and deliver project end-to-end.

  • Mission: autonomous security that keeps people and critical sites safe, including in defence.

  • Career path: a ground-floor seat with real runway. Prove your value and you will not have barriers to grow.

  • Team: work directly with PhD-level co-founders in AI, Robotics, and Physics, alongside a strong (and fun) founding team.

  • Compensation: Competitive equity/salary package

  • Culture: International founding team that is serious about building but does not take itself too seriously.

data.title: Software Engineer, Robot Autonomy (Localisation & State Estimation)
data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Software Engineer on Robot Autonomy, you will build and own the state estimation that tells our robots how they are moving and where they are. You'll fuse data from IMUs, cameras, LiDAR, GNSS, and platform-specific odometry into accurate, real-time estimates that support reliable autonomy day and night, across different robot platforms.

This is a builder's role first: you'll use the estimation methods and tools best suited to the problem, then do the engineering needed to make them work on real robots. Our robots operate in complex environments where terrain, weather, vibration, lighting, and sensor dropouts degrade measurements. We care less about novelty for its own sake and more about whether your systems perform reliably across platforms in the field.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Design and ship real-time estimators for position, orientation, velocity, and angular velocity across our robot platforms.

  • Fuse data from multiple sensors, handling noise, asynchronous measurements, calibration errors, changing sensor quality, and dropouts.

  • Develop estimation approaches suited to different platforms, including reusable components and interfaces that account for their distinct sensors and dynamics.

  • Improve localization and odometry in challenging conditions, including GNSS-denied environments and cases with degraded or intermittent sensing.

  • Integrate state estimation with perception, planning, and control so downstream systems receive reliable estimates and useful uncertainty information.

  • Investigate failures using logs, datasets, simulation, and field testing; identify root causes and verify that fixes improve performance on real robots.

  • Build evaluation and testing workflows that make estimator performance measurable and repeatable across robot types and operating conditions.

  • Work closely with the rest of Robot Autonomy and with forward-deployed engineers to turn deployment experience into improvements to the estimation stack.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for an engineer who has built or deployed state estimation systems for real robotic or autonomous platforms. You understand that estimator performance depends on the whole system: sensor behavior, calibration, timing, platform dynamics, and how autonomy uses the estimate.

You're comfortable choosing an approach based on the operational need, then making it robust through careful implementation, evaluation, and field validation. You measure success by whether robots operate reliably in the real world, not by algorithmic novelty alone.

YOUR BACKGROUND:

  • A Master's degree or PhD in mechanical engineering, computer science, robotics, electrical engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

  • Proven experience building or deploying state estimation, localization, or odometry systems for robots or autonomous systems (3+ years or equivalent depth).

  • Strong understanding of nonlinear state estimation, sensor fusion, Kalman filtering, and uncertainty representation.

data.description:
Our Mission

At Laelaps AI, we believe robotics is entering a transformative decade, much like the arrival of the internet. Advances in AI, cloud computing, and hardware are reshaping what autonomous systems can do. Our mission is to build the intelligent software that powers physical security in the real world - enabling robots and sensors to handle dangerous and critical tasks that humans shouldn't have to. By engineering the orchestration layer for intelligent security, we aim to create a world that is safer, more secure, and more resilient.

We're a strong founding team based in Zurich, backed by visionary investors and advisors. We are engineering the future of security today!

THE ROLE

As a Reinforcement Learning Intern on Robot Autonomy, you'll train locomotion and low-level control policies for our legged security robots and help take them from simulation to real hardware. You'll work close to the actuators, from joint-level behavior through coordinated locomotion, on robots that patrol outdoor sites across varied terrain and challenging weather.

This role is highly practical: you'll design training setups, run experiments in simulation, transfer policies to physical robots, and measure how they hold up. You'll get hands-on experience with the gap between a policy that works in simulation and one that keeps a robot on its feet on wet ground at night.

WHAT YOU'LL WORK ON

  • Train and evaluate reinforcement learning policies for locomotion and low-level control in simulation.

  • Apply sim-to-real techniques such as domain randomization, reward design, and policy robustness methods, and test the results on physical robots.

  • Make policies robust to varied terrain, challenging weather, and noisy, delayed, or missing sensor data.

  • Explore control approaches that transfer across robot embodiments with different actuators and dynamics.

  • Build evaluation workflows with clear metrics and repeatable experiments, in simulation and on hardware.

  • Apply solid engineering practices: experiment tracking, version control, reproducible training runs.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for a motivated robotics or machine learning student excited to apply academic training in a fast-moving startup. You'll be surrounded by a team that values learning, experimentation, and building things that actually work in the real world.

YOUR BACKGROUND:

  • Currently pursuing a PhD or recently completed a Master's degree in Robotics, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or a closely related field.

  • Hands-on experience training reinforcement learning policies for robot control, in simulation or on hardware.

  • Solid grounding in robot dynamics and control.
