data.description:
Technology that speaks your language

Domera Labs builds Ami, the first AI companion for seniors. Ami brings the power of a smartphone into a more human form: voice-first and deeply personalized

We at Domera Labs are rethinking human-machine interaction from first principles by introducing a better interface to interact with technology: voice

By combining the most intuitive hardware design with frontier AI, Ami makes AI accessible for the fastest growing demographic worldwide. The goal is to make the everyday life older adults more seamless, while addressing that generation's biggest challenge: loneliness and isolation. With Ami we are building the category leader of a new hardware paradigm by building a full standalone device (and not a gadget) that aims to makes the smartphones of today redundant.

The underlying technology of Ami combines a model-agnostic streaming pipeline consisting of proprietary models and off-the-shelf frontier models to create a hyper-personalized and proactive user experience. The backbone of Ami is built by our foundational lab that builds a social intelligence model that is optimized for social interaction, human behavior and interpersonal skills.

Domera Labs has secured large distribution agreements, a model co-development partnership with a leading AI lab, and ODM manufacturing proposals. We are looking for people who want to build at the intersection of human-machine interaction, mass-consumer facing hardware and shape frontier research with social/non-quantifiable benchmarking.


Core Responsibilities

You own the software that makes Ami work. Your primary responsibility is to architect, write and ship the on-device application and services for our mass-market consumer device, from voice interaction and cloud connectivity to onboarding, recovery and everyday reliability. You will work directly with our ODM and silicon partners to integrate that software with the underlying platform.

Our target hardware uses a Qualcomm SoC with Android/AOSP or embedded Linux depending on the final platform selection.

Our users are 75 years old and there is no screen, no settings menu, and no IT support. If the device does not work out of the box, it fails. Your job is to make the following work.

  • On-device application: build and own Ami's application and services, including interaction logic, real-time audio streaming, cloud communication, local state and recovery from network interruptions or service failures

  • Device identity and fleet management: provisioning, unique device identity, secure key storage, and the systems that let us know what every unit in the field is doing

  • The maintenance channel: a reliable service and diagnostics path to the device (BLE, USB-C, or both) for field debugging, factory test, and recovery

  • Out-of-the-box experience: first-boot network onboarding that a senior can complete alone, with no screen and no smartphone as a crutch. This is the single highest-stakes piece of the product

  • Flash and update management: partition layout, A/B OTA with rollback, staged fleet rollouts, and bricking as a category of bug that never happens

  • Base platform behaviors: boot and recovery, factory and soft resets, button and LED mappings, audio feedback, power states and battery behavior

  • The audio front end: working with our ODM and silicon partners on mic array, echo cancellation, wake word, and the latency budget from mic to first spoken token

  • Bringing the device through EVT, DVT, and PVT with our ODM as the technical counterpart on our side

 

What we are looking for

  • ⁠A builder's mindset: ship > fail > learn > improve

  • Stay focused when multiple priorities compete and the ranking is unclear

  • Work seamlessly across research and engineering

  • Can navigate ambiguity and make progress in fast-moving research environments

  • This is a founding-level position. You will work directly with the founders, shape the architecture from the ground up, and see your work in users' hands within months, not years.

 

Technical Requirements

  • You have shipped a connected consumer device to production, not just to a demo table. You know what goes wrong between DVT and mass production

  • Strong hands-on experience building production device applications and services on Android/AOSP, using Kotlin or Java and C/C++ for native components and hardware integration. You can own the on-device application end to end, including background execution, connectivity, audio and integration with platform services. Experience with embedded Linux is a plus; Python proficiency for tooling and testing is expected.

  • Experience developing for AOSP-based devices beyond standard smartphone apps: integrating privileged applications and services, working with system permissions and hardware interfaces, and collaborating with an ODM or silicon vendor on the underlying platform. Qualcomm platform experience is a plus.

  • Wireless connectivity in the real world: Wi-Fi provisioning, BLE, and ideally cellular. You have debugged a device that would not join a network in someone's home

  • OTA and flash: bootloaders, secure boot, A/B partitioning, rollback, and staged rollouts across a fleet

  • You can diagnose issues across application code, platform services and hardware interfaces

  • A builder's mindset: you'd rather ship and measure than debate

  • Bonus: real-time audio pipelines (I2S, DSP, AEC, wake word), on-device ML inference, factory test and manufacturing line bring-up, regulatory certification (CE, FCC), power optimization for battery life, experience in NLU / NLP

 

We lean toward senior engineers who can independently own production device software, but demonstrated ownership matters more than years of experience. Experience integrating real-time AI services into a consumer product is a plus.

 

What you get

data.description:
Camunda is the enterprise platform for agentic orchestration, enabling organizations to coordinate AI agents, people, and systems across complex, end-to-end business processes. With built-in governance, auditability, and human oversight, Camunda gives enterprises the control they need to move AI from pilots to production — safely and at scale. Trusted by over 700 organizations worldwide, including 9 of top 10 US banks, Camunda helps enterprises boost operational efficiency, accelerate time-to-value, and deliver better customer experiences.

Fully remote and global, we are in the middle of something bigger: transforming into an AI-first organisation, built on our own platform. We use Agentic AI to automate, orchestrate intelligent processes, and elevate human contribution across every team.

Named GP Bullhound’s Top 100 Next Unicorn list, 2025 Great Place to Work certified. Visionary in 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for Business Orchestration and Automation Technologies. ranked 3rd in Flexa's 2026 Most Flexible Companies, We’re growing fast and looking for top talent to join our team. If you want meaningful work, visible impact and put something genuinely rare on your CV, keep reading.

About the role:

We're hiring a Senior Software Engineer, Quality to build the agentic layer of how Camunda tests its software.

We treat quality as an engineering discipline. We build test infrastructure the way we build our product — real design decisions, real trade-offs, real ownership. What's changing is how that work gets done: we're moving from hand-written test suites toward agents that design, generate, maintain and triage tests across the lifecycle. We need someone to build both the agents and the infrastructure that makes them dependable, and to help shape our Quality AI strategy.

You'll support product teams that ship features without dedicated QA. Your job is not to become their testing safety net. It's to build the tooling and practices that let builders own quality themselves — and to stay close enough to real features to know where that tooling breaks.

Camunda also ships AI capabilities in its own product, so the evaluation practice you build for agent-driven testing feeds directly into how we test non-deterministic features.

You'll join colleagues who live our FAITH values: Focus, Ambition, Integrity, Talent and Humor.

Curious about the kind of challenges you'll work on at Camunda? Watch this quick 30-minute talk from our engineers to learn more about the new Camunda Exporter and how we’re solving complex problems at scale

What You’ll Be Doing:

  •  Build and operate agents across the testing lifecycle — test design, generation, maintenance, execution and failure triage.

  • Own the infrastructure that makes agent-driven testing reliable: environments, test data, tool interfaces, guardrails, runtime and cost control.

  • Define how we measure agent output quality, so teams can trust results instead of hand-reviewing them.

  • Apply that evaluation practice to testing Camunda 8's own AI capabilities.

  • Work hands-on with new features as teams build them, enough to keep the tooling honest.

  • Raise the quality capability of teams — patterns, tooling, enablement. Success is what builders can do themselves, not the number of tests you wrote.

What You Bring:

  • Ability and/or willingness to use our product

  •  5+ years as a software engineer. You write production code daily and would be credible on a product team; quality is your domain, not a step down from development.

  • Production experience building test infrastructure, developer tooling or internal platforms that other engineers depend on — designed and owned, not just extended.

  • Hands-on work with LLMs or agent frameworks: prompt and context design, tool use, handling non-determinism, and evaluating output quality. This is the differentiator for the role.

  • Comfort with distributed systems and CI at scale. Camunda 8 is a process orchestration platform; testing it means reasoning about concurrency, state and timing.

  • The ability to drive adoption in teams that don't report to you. You've built something another team chose to use, and you know what to do when the first version isn't picked up.

 Nice-to-haves:

  • Experience evaluating or benchmarking LLM systems.

  • Open-source contribution experience.

  • Java, TypeScript or Python; Kubernetes and Helm.

  • Background in developer tooling or platform engineering.

This role is an existing vacancy

Benefits & Perks

We invest in your wellbeing, growth, and ability to connect, along with perks that support you no matter where you’re based. Our benefits are globally designed and locally delivered where applicable.

  • In Person Connection: We invest in meaningful face time through our Annual Kickoff (Vienna in 2025, Madrid in 2026!), team offsites, and Camundi Connection Budgets, including contributing to meetups while travelling,, and local gatherings with fellow Camundi.

data.description:
Über die Stelle

Als Solution Engineer bei gateB übersetzt du komplexe Kundenanforderungen in tragfähige technische Lösungen. Du verbindest Beratung, Technologie und Umsetzung und begleitest unsere Kunden bei der Konzeption, Implementierung und Weiterentwicklung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen. 

Du arbeitest an anspruchsvollen nationalen und internationalen Projekten. Dabei begleitest du unsere Kunden von der ersten Idee über erste Prototypen und Pilotlösungen bis zur produktiven Einführung. Du übernimmst technische Verantwortung, arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Consultants, Entwicklungsteams und Technologiepartnern zusammen und stellst sicher, dass die Lösungen termingerecht, qualitativ hochwertig und mit erkennbarem Kundennutzen umgesetzt werden.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Analyse von Geschäftsprozessen und Kundenanforderungen sowie Erarbeitung von Systemkonzepten und Lösungsdesigns im direkten Austausch mit Kunden und internen Projektteams
  • Konzeption von Workflows, Customer Journeys, Datenflüssen und Schnittstellen sowie Erstellung umsetzbarer Briefings für Entwicklung und Implementation
  • Technische Konzeption, Spezifikation und Umsetzung von CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- und AI-Lösungen auf Basis von Partnertechnologien wie BSI und Salesforce sowie von gateB-eigenen Lösungen
  • Konfiguration und Implementierung von Cloud- und Enterprise-Lösungen einschliesslich Reports, Systemmasken, Daten- und Metadatenmodellen, Benutzerverwaltungen und Geschäftslogiken
  • Erstellung von Proof-of-Concepts und Minimum Viable Products, Unterstützung bei Aufwandsschätzungen sowie Begleitung von Daten-, Content- und Systemmigrationen und Integrationen
  • Übernahme der technischen Verantwortung und der Funktion als primäre technische Ansprechperson in Implementierungsprojekten sowie Sicherstellung von Zeit, Budget, Qualität und Kundenzufriedenheit
  • Koordination interner Entwicklungsteams sowie von Projektmitarbeitenden bei Partnern und Kunden; Sicherstellung von Testing, Qualitätssicherung, technischer Dokumentation, Schulungen und System-Roll-outs
  • Proaktive Ressourcenplanung, frühzeitiges Erkennen von Engpässen und kostenbewusste Beratung in der Umsetzung
  • Unterstützung des Sales-Prozesses durch RFIs, RFPs und Sales-Demos sowie Beobachtung und Einordnung neuer Technologien und Partnerlösungen im Hinblick auf Machbarkeit und Kundennutzen
  • Aufbau und Weiterentwicklung deines Know-hows, aktiver Wissenstransfer ins Team und zu unseren Kunden sowie Mitgestaltung von Software-Partnerschaften im Bereich AI und Enterprise Software


Dein Profil

  • Hochschulabschluss in Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang; alternativ eine technische Grundausbildung mit entsprechender Berufserfahrung
  • Ausgewiesene Erfahrung in der Konzeption, Implementation und Konfiguration von Enterprise-Software-Lösungen
  • Erfahrung mit CRM-, Marketing-Automation-, Daten- oder Content-Plattformen – idealerweise auf Dienstleisterseite
  • Praktische Erfahrung oder fundiertes Verständnis für die Anwendung von AI-Technologien und deren Integration in Geschäftsprozesse
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Kundenanforderungen, Systemdesign, Schnittstellen, Datenflüssen und Qualitätssicherung sowie Erfahrung mit Aufwandsschätzungen, technischer Dokumentation und interdisziplinärer Projektarbeit
  • Beratungs- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit mit tiefem technischem Verständnis, hoher technischer Affinität und Begeisterung für AI
  • Kundenorientierter, eigeninitiativ handelnder und lernfreudiger Umsetzer mit pragmatischer Arbeitsweise und Freude daran, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
  • Kommunikationsstark, zugänglich und souverän im Auftreten – mit der Fähigkeit, Vertrauen bei technischen und nicht-technischen Stakeholdern aufzubauen
  • Analytische, konzeptionelle und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie Verbindlichkeit in Koordination, Priorisierung und Umsetzung
  • Flexibel, reisefreudig und offen für die Zusammenarbeit mit Menschen aus unterschiedlichen Kulturen
  • Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse


Unser Angebot

  • Anspruchsvolle, abwechslungsreiche Rolle mit umfassender Eigenverantwortung und grossem Gestaltungsfreiraum
  • Spannende Projekte bei nationalen und internationalen Topkunden mit technisch hochstehenden Systemen
  • Möglichkeit, AI, digitale Transformation und Customer Experience bei Kunden wirksam zu verbinden
  • Interdisziplinäres Team mit flachen Hierarchien, offener Kommunikation und direktem Austausch mit der Unternehmensführung
  • Vielfältige Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten und aktive Förderung deiner fachlichen und persönlichen Entwicklung
  • Freiheit, eigene Ideen einzubringen und gateB aktiv mitzugestalten
  • Internationale Zusammenarbeit und interkultureller Austausch
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz in Steinhausen/Zug mit sehr guter Autobahn- und ÖV-Anbindung
  • Regelmässige Firmenevents, kostenfreie Getränke, Kaffee und frisches Obst sowie Zuschuss zum Mittagessen
  • 29 Tage Ferien sowie attraktive Mitarbeitervorteile und Vergünstigungen – weil uns Erholung, Work-Life-Balance und dein Wohl am Herzen liegen


Deine Bewerbung

Du möchtest technische Lösungen nicht nur konzipieren, sondern gemeinsam mit Kunden und interdisziplinären Teams auch wirkungsvoll umsetzen? Du hast Freude daran, komplexe Anforderungen zu strukturieren, Verantwortung zu übernehmen und neue Technologien wie AI in konkrete Geschäftslösungen zu übersetzen?

data.description:
About the role

Imagine owning the quality backbone of an aerospace company moving at full speed. While innovation accelerates around you, you ensure every design and every process meets the highest standards without slowing the momentum. As the Engineering Quality Manager, you will ensure that our engineering Organisation (including the Design Organization (DO)) maintains compliance with applicable standards and best practices (like EASA Part 21 Subpart J, EN9100). You’ll lead the development and oversight of our quality system, manage design supplier qualification and monitoring, drive internal and external audits and continuous improvement across all design, qualification and certification activities.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You´ll Do

  • Be responsible for establishing, documenting, developing and managing the Quality System and for ensuring that it continues to comply with regulatory requirements and business needs.
  • Support and guide our Engineering departments in the definition and implementation of efficient processes.
  • Oversee design supplier qualification, categorization, and ongoing performance monitoring.
  • Maintain and enhance the quality system, including document control, change management, and compliance monitoring
  • Monitor compliance of internal processes with established industry standards and certification authority requirements (such as EN9100, EASA Part 21J and required military standards).
  • Plan, conduct, and document internal and external audits in line with established processes.
  • Track and follow up on audit findings and corrective actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders and external auditors (e.g., EASA, MoD), and cross-functional teams to ensure compliance and quality standards are met.

Requirements

What You’ll Need

  • 7+ years in military or civil aviation or aerospace quality and compliance, or other highly quality driven industries such as automotive, energy with hands-on experience in the aviation industry
  • Experience with supplier quality management.
  • Track record in leading quality investigations, undertaking root cause analysis, developing corrective action plans, and ensuring the effectiveness of actions undertaken.
  • Audit training/certification or experience setting up  ISO 9001, AS9100, AQAP2110 quality systems required.
  • Familiarity with EASA Part 21 Subpart J and industry certification standards (e.g., DO-178C, DO-254, STANAGs).
  • Strong communication, analytical, and cross-functional collaboration skills

Who You Are

You are naturally detail obsessed but never lose sight of the bigger picture. You combine regulatory sharpness with practical engineering judgment and you know when to challenge and when to enable. Calm under pressure, you bring structure to complexity and clarity to ambiguity. You are assertive without ego, collaborative without compromising standards. When something is not compliant, you speak up. When a process can be better, you improve it.

data.title: Engineering Intern / Traineeship
data.description:
Imagine this. You are helping build the electronic foundation behind advanced aerospace and defence systems, making sure every component, symbol, footprint, and schematic detail is accurate before it reaches hardware.

As an Engineering Intern, you will work hands-on with Altium Designer and support our electronics engineers in creating and maintaining high-quality PCB design data. This is an opportunity to move beyond university projects and work with real engineering hardware where precision and attention to detail matter.

At Destinus, we are revolutionizing the defense industry with cutting-edge Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Our innovative technologies are designed to meet the unique demands of modern defense operations, delivering unparalleled speed, precision, and cost effectiveness. Destinus partners with government agencies and defense organizations worldwide to provide advanced solutions for mission-critical operations, enabling a new era of efficiency and technological superiority. Join us in shaping the future of defense with groundbreaking aerospace innovations.

What You'll Do

  • Create, review, and maintain electronic components, schematic symbols, footprints, and library data in Altium Designer
  • Read schematics and component datasheets to ensure design data accurately reflects manufacturer specifications
  • Support engineers with PCB design activities and help maintain clean, consistent, and reliable component libraries
  • Check existing components for errors, inconsistencies, and missing information before they make their way into hardware
  • Help improve library management, component validation, and engineering workflows
  • Use scripting and automation where useful to make repetitive checks faster and more reliable

Requirements

  • Currently studying toward a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, or a related field, or recently graduated
  • Hands-on experience with Altium Designer through university projects, personal PCB designs, or previous internships
  • Comfortable with schematic capture, library editors, and creating your own symbols and footprints
  • Ability to read schematics and datasheets, with a solid understanding of packages, pinouts, passive components, and common ICs
  • Strong attention to detail and a structured approach to technical work
  • Good written and spoken English
  • Experience with Altium 365 or another managed library environment is a plus
  • Familiarity with IPC-7351 footprint standards is an advantage
  • Basic Python or similar scripting experience for automation and bulk checks is a plus
  • Exposure to component lifecycle or obsolescence management is an advantage

Who You Are

You are curious, precise, and hands-on. You enjoy getting into the details and understand that a tiny mistake in a component library can become a very real hardware problem later. You work methodically, ask questions when something does not look right, and are excited to learn from experienced engineers while taking real ownership from day one.
